title: Idle cold-build measurement after the wasm and A2A SDK cuts
goal: Measure cold cargo build -p susi on an idle machine after T-CLAUDEWASMSTD-1 and T-CLAUDENOA2ASDK-1 against the morning baseline and record it in the lean-core wave log and .agents/build-time.jsonl.
results: Two idle runs: 61.7/61.3 s wall, 217.7/217.5 CPU-s, 342 units vs base 63.3 s, 228.6 CPU-s, 374 units.
limitations: 4-thread cloud container; the CEO laptop (28 threads) was not measured in this session.
